title: ACEF Delivery Verdict
description: Payload schema for delivery_verdict records. Records the state of delivering a finding to a customer/system-owner destination. Provider acknowledgment (HTTP 2xx) is not delivery — verified delivery requires a read-back of the destination object whose digest byte-equals the write digest, plus a signed harness_attestation. Cross-vendor concept per brief freddy-on-acef-requirements-v0.1.md §3.4. When delivery_state='verified_delivered', the triple requirement read_back + read_back.digest_match=true + harness_attestation_ref is enforced via allOf below.

verdict_id.description: URN identifier for this delivery verdict.

finding_ref.description: URN of the finding_record being delivered.

destination.description: Where the finding was (or was attempted to be) delivered.

provider_object_id.description: Provider-side object identifier (e.g., ticket URL or ID).

write_attempt.description: Record of the outbound write to the destination.

request_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the canonicalized request payload.

response_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the canonicalized response payload.

read_back.description: Read-back of the destination object after the write. REQUIRED when delivery_state='verified_delivered' (see allOf).

read_back_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the canonicalized read-back payload. MUST byte-equal write_attempt.request_digest when digest_match=true.

digest_match.description: Whether the read-back digest byte-equals the write request digest.

drift_classification.description: Required when delivery_state='drifted'. Classifies the kind of drift detected.

retry_history.description: Ordered array of prior write attempts.

harness_attestation_ref.description: URN of the harness_attestation that signed off on the verified_delivered transition. REQUIRED when delivery_state='verified_delivered' (see allOf).

allOf.description: Brief §3.4 triple-requirement: delivery_state='verified_delivered' REQUIRES read_back + read_back.digest_match=true + harness_attestation_ref. Missing any of these emits ACEF-071 at validation time. Per VAL-SCHEMA-004.
